title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations on College Road, Racine Drive, Kerr Avenue, Randall Parkway, and Emerson Street that UNCW currently serves with off-campus shuttles.

cards.title: College Road at Harris Teeter
cards.subtitle: College Road corridor • 710 Red Shuttle stop 1156
cards.notes: Use this College Road stop when the 710 Red Shuttle is running; confirm the current route map and service calendar before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A named College Road destination on UNCW’s Red Shuttle route.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “College Rd at Harris Teeter (1156)” as a stop on the 710 Red Shuttle.
cards.access_notes: UNCW publishes this as an off-campus shuttle stop; check the current shuttle schedule before travel.

cards.title: University Commons
cards.subtitle: New Centre Drive corridor • 710 Red and 712 Teal stop 1312
cards.notes: Plan this stop as a transfer-friendly off-campus destination: both the 710 Red and 712 Teal routes list it in their current stop sequences.
cards.short_summary: A named University Commons stop served by two UNCW shuttle routes.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “New Center at University Commons (1312)” on both the 710 Red and 712 Teal shuttles.
cards.access_notes: UNCW identifies University Commons as a stop on both routes; consult the active schedule and route map.

cards.title: Racine Drive at Wilmington Commons
cards.subtitle: Racine Drive corridor • 710 Red and 712 Teal stop 1911

cards.short_summary: A northbound Racine Drive stop for Wilmington Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “Racine Dr at Wilmington Commons NB (1911)” on the 710 Red and 712 Teal shuttles.
cards.access_notes: UNCW’s route page identifies this northbound stop; service timing varies by route and academic calendar.

cards.title: Kerr Avenue and Hoggard Drive

cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “Kerr Ave & Hoggard Dr (1414)” as a 710 Red Shuttle stop.
cards.access_notes: This is a current UNCW off-campus shuttle stop; verify operating days and route updates before travel.

cards.title: Kerr Avenue at Candlewyck

cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “Kerr Ave at Candlewyck NB (1415)” as a 710 Red Shuttle stop.

cards.evidence_claim: UNCW lists “Kerr Ave at Patrick NB (1417)” as a 710 Red Shuttle stop.

cards.title: Randall Parkway at Campus Cove
